|combos=* Vul Tazaenne + [[Red Leader]] in [[Red 1]]/Gold [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]] in [[Gold 1]] + 2 Landing Claws + [[Kiffex (Jabba's Palace){{!}}Kiffex]] = The coolness of this is it's simplicity. This is not a 6 card combo, but a situation that you can prepare for. You will have the ability to drain for two at [[Kiffex (Jabba's Palace){{!}}Kiffex]] while keeping a safe distance from your opponent. If they decide to battle you, hide. If you draw any of these cards for destiny, they are all a two's. Also, if you control [[Kiffex (Jabba's Palace){{!}}Kiffex]] itself with the two starships, Vul will add 4 to all 4's.
